caveat: Pre-2023 ordinances were migrated from Legistar; their district codes come from OCR of scanned PDFs. Districts are the change as written in the ordinance or committee agenda; where only the as-introduced text of a substitute ordinance was readable, the City map's district is used. Ward values use today's ward map, not the map in force when it passed. Of the rezonings matched to the City zoning map, 97.7% agree with it; conflicts with the passed ordinance text are kept as the text reads (the Council's Journal of Proceedings backs the text in 37 of 38 checked) and flagged (map_check).

rezonings.value: one point per zoning map amendment the City Council passed; properties.passed_date, from/to district, upzoning, downzoning, to_multifamily, pd_or_pmd, far_delta, capacity_sqft_delta

rezonings_far_known.value: the passed rezonings whose before and after floor-area ratio are both known (the base for the upzoning share)

rezonings_use_known.value: the passed rezonings whose before and after residential use permissions are both known (the base for the multifamily share)

zoned_single_family.value: 1 where the zoning district is RS-1, RS-2 or RS-3 (residential single-unit), 0 in any other district, NaN off the zoning map

zoned_multifamily.value: 1 where the zoning district is an RT or RM residential district, 0 in any other district, NaN off the zoning map

zoned_business_commercial.value: 1 where the zoning district is a B (business) or C (commercial) district, 0 in any other district, NaN off the zoning map

zoned_manufacturing.value: 1 where the zoning district is an M (manufacturing) district or a Planned Manufacturing District, 0 in any other district, NaN off the zoning map

zoned_planned_development.value: 1 where the zoning district is a Planned Development, 0 in any other district, NaN off the zoning map

zoned_max_far.value: the district's maximum floor-area ratio, NaN off the zoning map and where the district sets none (PD, POS)

rezonings_passed_per_km2.label: Rezonings Passed
rezonings_passed_per_km2.description: Zoning map changes the City Council passed per square kilometer in the year.
rezonings_passed_per_km2.methodology: Count of passed zoning map amendments (Type 1, standard and aldermanic) per km², by year passed. Ordinances come from the City Clerk's eLMS (matterCategory ZONING RECLASSIFICATIONS); from/to districts are read from each ordinance PDF (OCR where scanned) or the Zoning Committee agenda, checked against (and, for missed PD steps or where only a request was readable, completed from) the City's zoning-district map, placed at the rezoned map polygon (else the Census geocoder), and counted in the calendar year the City Council passed them.

rezonings_upzoning_share.label: Upzoning Share
rezonings_upzoning_share.description: Of the year's rezonings, the share that raised how much building the lot allows.
rezonings_upzoning_share.methodology: Share of passed rezonings whose new district has a higher maximum floor-area ratio than the old one (Chicago Zoning Ordinance FAR tables, 17-2-0304, 17-3-0403, 17-4-0405, 17-5-0404; a Planned Development takes its underlying district's FAR per 17-8-0901). Rezonings with an unknown FAR on either side are left out. Ordinances come from the City Clerk's eLMS (matterCategory ZONING RECLASSIFICATIONS); from/to districts are read from each ordinance PDF (OCR where scanned) or the Zoning Committee agenda, checked against (and, for missed PD steps or where only a request was readable, completed from) the City's zoning-district map, placed at the rezoned map polygon (else the Census geocoder), and counted in the calendar year the City Council passed them.

rezonings_to_multifamily_share.label: Multifamily Rezonings
rezonings_to_multifamily_share.description: Of the year's rezonings, the share that newly allowed apartment buildings (3+ units).
rezonings_to_multifamily_share.methodology: Share of passed rezonings to a district that permits multi-unit (3+) residential from one that did not (use tables 17-2-0207, 17-3-0207, 17-4-0207). Ordinances come from the City Clerk's eLMS (matterCategory ZONING RECLASSIFICATIONS); from/to districts are read from each ordinance PDF (OCR where scanned) or the Zoning Committee agenda, checked against (and, for missed PD steps or where only a request was readable, completed from) the City's zoning-district map, placed at the rezoned map polygon (else the Census geocoder), and counted in the calendar year the City Council passed them.

zoned_capacity_added_sqft_per_km2.label: Zoned Capacity Added
zoned_capacity_added_sqft_per_km2.description: Net floor area that the year's rezonings added to what the zoning allows, in square feet per km².
zoned_capacity_added_sqft_per_km2.methodology: Σ (new max FAR − old max FAR) × lot area over passed rezonings, per km². Lot area = Cook County 2021 parcels whose centroid lies in the rezoned City zoning-map polygon (else the parcels at the ordinance's address range); rezonings with unknown FAR or lot area add nothing, so this is a floor. Ordinances come from the City Clerk's eLMS (matterCategory ZONING RECLASSIFICATIONS); from/to districts are read from each ordinance PDF (OCR where scanned) or the Zoning Committee agenda, checked against (and, for missed PD steps or where only a request was readable, completed from) the City's zoning-district map, placed at the rezoned map polygon (else the Census geocoder), and counted in the calendar year the City Council passed them.

zoned_single_family_only_pct.label: Single-Family Zoning
zoned_single_family_only_pct.description: Share of the area's zoned land where only houses may be built, no apartment buildings.
zoned_single_family_only_pct.methodology: Share of the zoned land (every cell inside a zoning district, downtown, parks and transportation districts included) whose district is RS-1, RS-2 or RS-3: detached houses only (RS-3 also allows two-flats), with multi-unit (3+) residential prohibited (17-2-0207). City of Chicago Boundaries - Zoning Districts (dj47-wfun) as downloaded 2026-10-19, rasterized to a 10 m grid (cell centres); the polygons run to street and alley centrelines.

zoned_multifamily_pct.label: Multifamily Zoning
zoned_multifamily_pct.description: Share of the area's zoned land in residential districts that allow two-flats, townhouses and apartment buildings.
zoned_multifamily_pct.methodology: Share of the zoned land (every cell inside a zoning district, downtown, parks and transportation districts included) whose district is RT-3.5 through RM-6.5, the residential districts that permit multi-unit (3+) residential by right (17-2-0207). Business, commercial and downtown districts that also allow apartments are not counted here. City of Chicago Boundaries - Zoning Districts (dj47-wfun) as downloaded 2026-10-19, rasterized to a 10 m grid (cell centres); the polygons run to street and alley centrelines.

zoned_business_commercial_pct.label: Business Zoning
zoned_business_commercial_pct.description: Share of the area's zoned land in business or commercial districts, where shops and offices may go.
zoned_business_commercial_pct.methodology: Share of the zoned land (every cell inside a zoning district, downtown, parks and transportation districts included) whose district is a B1–B3 business or C1–C3 commercial district (17-3). Downtown districts are not counted. City of Chicago Boundaries - Zoning Districts (dj47-wfun) as downloaded 2026-10-19, rasterized to a 10 m grid (cell centres); the polygons run to street and alley centrelines.

zoned_manufacturing_pct.label: Manufacturing Zoning
zoned_manufacturing_pct.description: Share of the area's zoned land set aside for industry.
zoned_manufacturing_pct.methodology: Share of the zoned land (every cell inside a zoning district, downtown, parks and transportation districts included) whose district is an M1–M3 manufacturing district (17-5) or a Planned Manufacturing District (17-6-0400). City of Chicago Boundaries - Zoning Districts (dj47-wfun) as downloaded 2026-10-19, rasterized to a 10 m grid (cell centres); the polygons run to street and alley centrelines.

zoned_planned_development_pct.label: Planned Developments
zoned_planned_development_pct.description: Share of the area's zoned land under a Planned Development, rules negotiated for one large project.
zoned_planned_development_pct.methodology: Share of the zoned land (every cell inside a zoning district, downtown, parks and transportation districts included) whose district is a Planned Development (17-8), whose uses and bulk are set by its own ordinance rather than a base district. City of Chicago Boundaries - Zoning Districts (dj47-wfun) as downloaded 2026-10-19, rasterized to a 10 m grid (cell centres); the polygons run to street and alley centrelines.

zoned_far_mean.label: Zoned FAR
zoned_far_mean.description: How much building the zoning allows, on average: floor area per square foot of land.
zoned_far_mean.methodology: Area-weighted mean of each district's maximum floor-area ratio over the zoned land (data/districts.csv, from Chicago Zoning Ordinance 17-2-0304, 17-3-0403, 17-4-0405, 17-5-0404, 17-6-0405; bonuses not included). Planned Developments, parks (POS) and PMDs without a set FAR are left out. City of Chicago Boundaries - Zoning Districts (dj47-wfun) as downloaded 2026-10-19, rasterized to a 10 m grid (cell centres); the polygons run to street and alley centrelines.
